title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Sat 31 Oct
summary: The upslope ran from about 08:15 to about 15:30. A low day for October: the base stayed down near 3,700 ft (normal 4,500–5,400 ft). The evening before, the page called it normal, about 4,100 ft, a miss. Midday the base averaged about 3,700 ft by the Kekoa camera, 400 ft lower than the evening's number; the morning update said about 3,800 ft, off by 100 ft. Most of the day the shear line was on Makawao Avenue near Makawao, running toward Kahului; furthest north about 09:06, north of Pukalani, reaching the coast near Haiku; furthest south about 08:28, crossing Kula Highway between the middle Lower Kula Road junction and Waiakoa. Data gaps: Nakula stopped at 14:15; the Mesonet could not be reached on 27 of 90 updates.
